title: Sent back to a building
description: A New Yorker-style single-panel cartoon: a kid playing on a TV with an Amazon Fire Stick, whose thought bubble is a data center, and under it in Caslon italic: “It took 40 years to make computers smarter and mobile, now every bit of information gets sent back to a building.” The ground is the drawing's own paper. No logo by default.
source: The brief (Nov 2026): the cartoon is a Gemini image (assets/cartoon.jpg, 2160 px wide from the 2400×1792 original), the caption is the brief's. Caption type: Libre Caslon Text Italic (SIL Open Font License, assets/OFL.txt), by request (New Yorker caption style); the brand's Outfit isn't used here.
